transcript:
# Town of Sutton

Historic Commission Meeting Minutes

August 25, 2026

Meeting Started at 7:05 p.m.

**Members Present:**

Paul Dunn - Chair

Mark Brown - Clerk

Wally Baker - Member

Rochelle Forsythe - Member

Donald McKinnon - Member

**Members Absent:**

None

## Review and Approve Minutes:

All members had received and reviewed April 28, 2026 and June 23, 2026 minutes.

- Motion to approve the minutes made and seconded.
- Vote:
  - R. Forsythe - Approved
  - P. Dunn - Approved April, abstained for June (was not present).
  - M. Brown - Approved
  - D. McKinnon - Approved
  - W. Baker - Approved
- Result: Motion passed unanimously. Prior meeting minutes approved.

**Public Forum:** No public in attendance.

**Public Hearing:** No public hearings scheduled.

**Board Business:** See Old Business

## Old Business:

**Civil War Veterans Memorial at Town Hall Entrance**

- W. Baker did check the vault for the GAR Star, it was not present. He also asked around Town Hall staff with no further success.
- D. McKinnon updated the commission that the memorials (Entrance and cannons), previously believed to be in the national GAR database, were not entered. That has been corrected.

**Town Common Changes - Parking**

- M. Brown and D. McKinnon attended the Select Board meeting in which the parking issues where discussed. M. Brown reported that the meeting was overall positive and there were no pre-conceived plans. The Town Manager was actively looking for ideas to resolve the parking issues. No decisions were made regarding parking and general consensus was to avoid alteration of the Common and explore other options (Uxbridge Rd lot, which was purchased by the Town as a future site for municipal buildings or possibly making Church Circuit one-way and converting the current second lane to parking). Other Common related topic was the removal of 5 trees that were evaluated by an Arborist and found to be unhealthy and a public safety issue. Four of these trees are Memorial Trees, these will be replaced with mature trees of a disease resistant variety. W. Baker mentions that there are Town stipulations regarding any removed tree be replaced a new tree somewhere in the community.

## New Business:

**Municipal Representation**

- W. Baker is wondering if we, like the other organizations, have a Town employee associated with the Commission. General consensus is other then general support of Town Clerk and Communications for scheduling and posting meeting information, there is no dedicated representative.

## Announcements / Correspondence:

Notification of Town Meeting on October 19, 2026.

**Set Next Meeting** *(The commission's regular meeting date is the 4th Tuesday of the month)*:

None set at this time.

\* A motion to adjourn was made and seconded, it was carried. Meeting adjourned at 7:25 p.m.

Respectfully Submitted:

Mark Brown - Clerk

Paul Dunn, Chair
